name: io.github.peteratpondo/kit-memory-demo
description: Kit is an identity substrate for AI agents: not another agent, not a memory API. It is the durable, local-first self beneath your tools: memory with provenance, soul, handoffs, and context that outlives any context window. It dreams: nightly consolidation links, dedupes, and supersedes without erasing. Whichever model you run wakes up as the same collaborator tomorrow. This live read-only demo holds an invented world no model was trained on, so correct citations are provably retrieval; sibling servers hold the mystery's other half and a real engineering case file with GitHub receipts. Public read key: demo.kit-project.com/llms.txt.
